stem:
On the grid below, draw the reflection of the shape in the dotted line of symmetry.

[Image: Grid with a polygon and a dashed line of symmetry]

codes.response: One or more of image lines drawn correctly, but image not completely correct
Attempt to sketch an image under a transformation other than reflection (e.g., translation of image)
Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description:
An 8 by 8 grid of square cells with a vertical dashed line of symmetry running along the central vertical grid line (between the 4th and 5th columns from the left).
To the right of the dashed line is a six-sided polygon with vertices at grid intersections (with column lines 0 to 8 from left to right, and row lines 0 to 8 from top to bottom):
- (column 4, row 3) on the dashed line
- (column 5, row 2)
- (column 6, row 4)
- (column 7, row 4)
- (column 7, row 6)
- (column 4, row 5) on the dashed line

The edges of the polygon connect these vertices in sequence:
- A straight segment from (4, 3) up and right to (5, 2)
- A segment from (5, 2) down and right to (6, 4)
- A horizontal segment from (6, 4) to (7, 4)
- A vertical segment from (7, 4) down to (7, 6)
- A slanted segment from (7, 6) up and left to (4, 5)
- A vertical segment of length 2 along the dashed line from (4, 5) up to (4, 3)
